Elaine W: Quick follow-up from PM postmortem — three remediation items need owners + Jira tickets. Can everyone confirm and update the linked tickets by EOD Thu? Summary:

1) Retry/backoff tuning — reduce 503 spikes for short bursts. R/A: Sam K, C: Priya R, I: Oncall SRE. Due 2026-03-30. Jira INF-9876
2) Cache eviction policy (TTL & size) — reduce cache thrash on shard failovers. R/A: Jorge M, C: Chris L, I: Platform. Due 2026-04-06. Jira INF-9877
3) Alert runbook + threshold tuning — reduce noisy paging for transient errors. R/A: Priya R, C: SRE & Support, I: Eng leads. Due 2026-03-27. Jira INF-9878

Please reply with 'ack' + any blockers. If you want to reassign, say so and propose a new owner.

Elaine W: RACI snippet for clarity:
```
- R: Responsible (do the work)
- A: Accountable (signs off)
- C: Consulted
- I: Informed
```

Sam K: ack — I will own INF-9876. I'll draft proposed backoff values, run perf tests, and post results. Need 2x dev-dedicated GPUs for ~2h to reproduce the spike pattern. Will open infra request. :thumbsup:

Jorge M: taking INF-9877. I'll add acceptance criteria + TTL matrix. Planning to pair with @Chris L for cache sizing next Tue.

Priya R: INF-9878 ack. I'll work on the runbook and threshold tuning. Suggest we add a validation metric: 'recurring 5xx rate > 0.5% over 1h' as a detection signal. Will schedule a dry-run with Support on Fri.

Chris L: ok — can pair Tue 10am PT for cache sizing. Also think we should add a short circuit-breaker test to the perf plan.

Elaine W: Thanks — please ensure the Jira RACI fields are filled (R/A/C/I). For any change of owner, ping me and update the ticket comment with reason. If perf tests need dedicated capacity, @Sam K please link the infra request ticket in INF-9876.

Sam K: filed INF-9901 for infra request (2x dev-dedicated for 2h). Linking: https://jira.redwood/INF-9901 -> added to INF-9876.

Jorge M: added acceptance criteria and test plan to INF-9877. Tagging @Chris L for review.

Priya R: scheduled runbook dry-run with Support for Fri 11am PT and put calendar invite. Added proposed thresholds to INF-9878.

Chris L: reviewed INF-9877 comments, left a note about cache warmup timing.

Elaine W: small ask — can each owner add 1-2 success criteria in the Jira ticket (what counts as 'done' beyond just code changes)? We want measurable sign-off for the postmortem closure.

Sam K: adding perf graphs and smoke validation script as success criteria.

Jorge M: adding "<1% cache miss amplification on failover" and "no regression in p95 latency" as acceptance.

Priya R: adding "runbook validated with Support (dry-run)" and "thresholds produce <1 noisy alert per week" as success criteria.

Elaine W: perfect. I'll do a short RACI audit on Mon to make sure nothing is unassigned. If any of you need to re-scope due to capacity or cross-team dependencies, call it out in the ticket.

Priya R: one potential blocker — SRE is overloaded next week. If runbook dry-run conflicts, I may need Chris to step in for the Support pairing. Will flag by Wed.

Sam K: noted. If infra provisioning is delayed, I can do a reduced-scope perf run on smaller instances to validate the backoff behavior.

Elaine W: ok — thanks everyone. I'll follow up after the RACI audit. :raised_hands:
